lines.en: I make my way over to the dojo to practice karate with Osako.
lines.zh: 我走向道场,打算和 Osako 一起练空手道。

lines.en: I actually came here to slack off and closely monitor all of the girls actually trying to learn a martial art in hopes of catching a glimpse of a wardrobe malfunction or two.
lines.zh: 其实我是来这里摸鱼的,顺便密切监视那些真心想学武道的女孩们,指望能瞄到一两次走光。

lines.en: As you may be able to tell, Osako does not like that part of me very much.
lines.zh: 你大概看得出来,Osako 不怎么喜欢我的这一面。

lines.en: In fact, she dislikes it so much that she proceeds to make a laughing stock of me in front of everyone by body slamming me onto the floormat and sitting on me for a full twenty minutes.
lines.zh: 事实上,她讨厌到直接把我摔在垫子上、然后在我身上坐了整整二十分钟,当着所有人的面把我变成了笑柄。

lines.en: I have no idea how someone so light can have so much power- and I am also afraid to ask as I fear it would just lead to me being hit again.
lines.zh: 我真不明白这么轻的人哪来这么大的力气——我也不敢问,怕问了只会再挨一顿打。

lines.en: Osako ultimately decides to spare my life and allows me to sit through the rest of the class without physically abusing me again.
lines.zh: Osako 最终饶了我一命,允许我坐完剩下的课,没有再对我进行物理虐待。

lines.en: That is, until she catches me staring at her and then decides that my punishment is nowhere near complete.
lines.zh: 也就是说,直到她抓到我在盯着她看,然后判定我的惩罚还远远没有结束。

lines.en: And, in other news, I really don't understand why I keep coming here.
lines.zh: 另外播报一条新闻:我真不理解自己为什么老往这里跑。
Osako 的好感度提升到了 [osako_love]!
